history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

4.2.6-reborn-rust-main-d9ff9808.label: borg-reborn-rs d9ff9808, main at the merge of #550 (stair-scum threat). harness/borg.txt 9860fba9... ships the named list on (from harness/scary_monsters.txt, d045111b...) with the damage rule at 60, cornered mode on, the borg-rs core and no plan; caution_rising_explore_ticks is the compiled 300.

experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-18: the owner chose a 2x2 of caution_cornered_danger_tenths (5, 10) x caution_cornered_radius (2, 4) on current main, cornered mode on and the big-level margin at its shipped 0 (borg-zoo#224). Pilot first (RULES 16).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-18, before any result was read (borg-zoo#224). Pilot only. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each
arm's settings written in its borg.txt; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls, purchase bursts
and key outliers listed. Descriptive: deaths and causes per class (CL1-3 deaths counted), mean max level and depth;
paired against d10-r2 (the shipped values); from replays, the cornered-mode notes (buffs, Monster Confusion) per
arm. 18 starts per arm cannot show whether either change helps; all 1,800 starts only on the owner's go.
experiment.question: Does cornered mode save more games if it triggers earlier (danger at half the HP) or from further away?
